summary: Otherwise, for each i ≤ |n|, some eigenvalue λ_i of A has ‖1 − y^iλ_i‖ < 1: det(1 − y^iA) is the product of the 1 − y^iλ over the eigenvalues λ of A, and if every factor had norm ≥ 1, then ‖det(1 − T(φ))‖ ≥ 1 near δ_i (T continuous, T(δ_i) = y^iA). Then ‖y^iλ_i‖ = 1, and the λ_i are pairwise distinct because ‖y^{j−i} − 1‖ = 1 for 1 ≤ j − i ≤ |n|: |n| + 1 distinct roots of a characteristic polynomial of degree |n|, a contradiction. No integrality of A or of T is used: the statement gives none.
